comments.author: @Silentearth91
comments.text: The Lost Sea in Tennessee being the largest underground lake in the US was the fact that stopped me — I had no idea a lake that size existed underground. The point about Tornado Alley shifting east also stood out, because it changes how you think about where that risk actually sits now. And the Alaska comparison, bigger than Texas, California and Montana combined, is still hard to picture even after seeing it laid out like that.
